about_the_game:
Build a moody city with the Spirit of England tileset for RPG Maker! From the streets to the pubs, this tileset has you covered.

The Spirit of England tileset includes:

Ground Tiles:

water, grass, dirt, etc.
wood floor
Cobble tile (large rock and small)
Concrete and asphalt
3 wood inlay floor tiles
Grass and flower overlays
street stripes
wall-growing ivy
modern fence

Walls:

plain painted walls – charcoal, blue, red, green
4 wood walls, 1 plain, 1 panel, 2 with decorative edges
gray roof (with shadow-side tile)
stone walls – plain, brick edge, 3 with panels, 1 with pillars
2 styles of brick wall (large and small brick)
walls to match cobble and wood inlay
hedge wall

Also included:

Stairs to match floors
wide variety of wood furniture – shelves, tables, endtables and cabinets (shelves have three variations with different decorative items, plus 1 plain version you can customize)
radiator
chairs and sofas in several styles (cream-colored with wood details)
Wall art/paintings
large chandelier, lit
chimneys in 2 styles (with and without decorative mantles)
beds (with and without canopies)
grand staircase
outdoor awnings in three lengths
outdoor lights (on and off)
benches
telephone box
signs (with template to make your own)
store windows (with and without goods)
decorative architecture elements – pillars, arch, cupolas, edges, window frames
bus stop (with Routemaster bus)
wood-toned cash registers
fashion store – lit shelves, mannequins (clothed and unclothed) men’s and women’s clothes, shoes
grocery goods – meats, cheeses, bakery, vegetables
pub tiles – tables, padded seats (some with 90 degree angle) glassware (empty and full), keg, taps, dart board, wall art
cafe – plates (with and without food) menus, signs, cups
roof tiles
trees
bridge tiles
lots of windows – lit and unlit, wood and stone edge, curtains you can overlay
and more!


Events and Animations

Door animations with lit and unlit interiors – wood and cream color
Fireplace animation
Routemaster bus

* Also comes with Sample Map for MV/MZ


Terms of Use:

* This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
* OK to be used in Commercial projects
* Contents can be edited
* OK for use in games with gore
* OK for use in adult-rated games
